competitorResearch: VERIFIED ONLINE: (1) Uzbek-language SERP for this game is effectively EMPTY — queries like "Magic Chess Go Go olmos sotib olish O'zbekiston" and "'magic chess' olmos to'ldirish Payme Click UzCard Humo" returned zero relevant results, only Wikipedia/Google Play and Uzbek gambling-affiliate spam (Mostbet, BetWinner, FairPari). There is no Uzbek-language competitor page for MCGG topup at all. This is the single strongest finding: a first-mover land grab. (2) Russian SERP IS contested but by RU-domestic resellers only: KupiKod, Donatov.net, IGM.GG, GroguPay, GalaxyLink, HornyBox, Smile One, PayClarus, CoolGameService, LuukeDonate. None are Uzbekistan-oriented, none list UzCard/HUMO/Click/Payme — so any RU query qualified with "узбекистан" / local payment is winnable. (3) ID mechanics verified: MCGG requires User ID + Zone/Server ID in the format 100000520(1234); found by tapping the avatar in the upper-left corner, or via profile "Основная информация"/Basic Info. Donatov.net uses the wording "ID вашего профиля в игре" + "ID сервера, на котором играете". (4) BIG CONTENT GAP: neither Codashop nor donatov.blog's "how to donate" guide actually explains WHERE in the game to find the ID — donatov.blog only says "Внимательно проверьте все цифры!". A real step-by-step ID guide has zero real competition. (5) Package tiers verified from Codashop: 55, 275, 565, 1160, 1770, 2975, 4165, 6000 diamonds, plus a Weekly Pass and Go Go Pass (1750 diamonds). These are diamond COUNTS, not so'm prices, so they are safe to publish under the no-invented-prices rule. (6) Codashop does NOT verify/display the player nickname before payment — confirmed on its page. GemPay's free pre-payment nickname check is therefore a genuine, provable differentiator, not marketing fluff. (7) Region trap is REAL: donatov.blog shows separate server products "Для России" / "Глобальный" / "Турция", and Smile One sells a distinct "Magic Chess: Go Go (Россия)" SKU. Uzbek players are on Global/APAC, so a wrong-region purchase fails or lands elsewhere. (8) Delivery-time gap: donatov.net states "среднее время доставки около 10 минут" and admits it can stretch to hours under load; GemPay's ~2 min is a defensible comparison point. (9) MLBB confusion confirmed: MCGG is a separate app (Google Play packages com.mobilechess.gp global and com.mobilechess.us US) that links to the same Moonton account for cross-game rewards — so users genuinely have one Moonton account but distinct game IDs. (10) Diamond sinks verified via BlueStacks guides: Go Go Pass (seasonal skins, emotes, star protection cards, accessories, star-up effects), commander skins, chessboard cosmetics, limited bundles; commanders cost 150 diamonds but Chess Points are the better route. (11) Scam demand is real: a "Magic Chess Go Go Hack Tool Gold Generator No Human Verification" spam page ranks in English SERP, justifying the trust/safety angle. INFERRED, NOT VERIFIED: exact search volumes and keyword difficulty — the Ahrefs and Semrush connectors in this session are unauthorized, so no volume data could be pulled; all volume claims are qualitative. Russian-with-UZ-qualifier = light, beatable on payment-method relevance. Global English = saturated (SEAGM, MooGold, Codashop, Eneba) — do not chase it.
